selection_method: Stratified expansion of the immutable 64-artifact v4 corpus to 300 named artifacts. The 64 v4 entries are retained byte for byte so outcome deltas are attributable to the script-prefix-classification.v1 consumer revision alone. The additions are one wheel per project selected from the hugovk top-pypi-packages 30-day snapshot (retrieved 2026-08-28, https://hugovk.github.io/top-pypi-packages/top-pypi-packages.min.json, SHA-256 bb36eb336787975315f66eb0834073e9b0a72593c486cd2d704991046f465b04) walked in download-rank order after explicit native-CLI, .data-bearing, headers-scheme, and build-backend injections, under per-platform cohort quotas (manylinux and musllinux x86_64, manylinux aarch64, Windows x86_64, macOS arm64/x86_64/universal2, universal), a 50 MiB per-artifact ceiling, and a one-gigabyte addition budget. Declared Metadata-Version values were prospected over PEP 658 metadata endpoints before download; artifacts whose download or digest failed were dropped and recorded rather than substituted.
